rows.ARS:
Light pink Shrub.
Registration name: Anastasie
Exhibition name: Anastasie
rows.Origin:
Bred by Warren Millington (Australia, 2009).
Introduced in Belgium by Daniel Schmitz Roses / Roses du Temps Passé / Les Roses de Daniel in 2014 as 'Anastasie'.
rows.Bloom: Light pink, light yellow undertones. Moderate fragrance. Average diameter 4.5". Medium to large, full (26-40 petals), in small clusters, old-fashioned bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, upright, well-branched. Medium, matte, medium green foliage.

Height: up to 4'11" (up to 150cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, garden or shrub. Disease susceptibility: disease resistant.
rows.Parentage:
Great Southern Skies ×
Madame Caroline Testout (Hybrid Tea, Pernet-Ducher, 1887)
